title: Project credits: National Endowment for the Arts and Jazz Interactions
summary: Johnston credits the NEA, Jazz Interactions and Pastor John Gensel.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: At this point I would like to say that this interview has been a project supported by The National
Endowment for the Arts in Washington. As a matter of fact, it is one of their projects and has been administered by the Jazz Interaction in New York for which Lois McCloud is the project coordinator.

The whole project has been developed in cooperation with Pastor John Gensel known affectionately and wisely in New York as the priest to the jazz community. He is an associate pastor at St. Peter's Lutheran Church. And is very, very well known for his jazz projects.
